title: Dip before the first high
description: The snippet starts at 24,944 and dips to 24,151 before any close beats the start, so at level 1 that dip is the first low. The first high is 25,018 (16 Mar 10:00), and 25,027 at 19:00 is a higher high by 9. The recovery's own highs and lows appear a level down, at level 2. The final close, 25,052, is the snippet high and already a higher high; a higher next close would move it forward.
